title: Organization goals and authority
caption: Production synthetic owner: two organization goals saved and reloaded. HR and admin creation passed separately.
facts: Who sets organization-wide OKRs?
Authorized owner, admin and HR manager. Department heads and team leads use their granted department/team scope; employees manage their own goals.
Goals and authority were exercised
Organization, department, team and individual goals saved/reloaded. Approvals, revision reasons, progress, alignment, scoped pickers and forbidden reads were tested.
Ten acknowledged appraisal results

Ten of twelve original QA appraisals reached human final publication, employee acknowledgement and own results/history. Two intentionally unfinished cases verify pending work and unrated draft recovery. Later Momo results are counted separately.
note: The baseline covers sixteen genuine OIDC identities in two QA organizations; later Momo journeys are separate. Full API run: 1,236/1,237 original expectations matched. The remaining response correctly denied access with 403; its source-aligned follow-up passed 10/10. Both receipts are retained.

title: Starting and completing appraisals
caption: Production HR launch: Active, one employee and one pending self-assessment, with no aligned-goal prerequisite.
facts: Managers can begin reviews for their staff
Owner, admin, HR, line manager, department head and team lead each launched within authorized scope. Selected reviewers, configured steps and discussion actions led to completed human decisions.
Cycle setup follows the visible design

HR launched a saved competency-only template with goals disabled and weights of 0% goals / 100% competencies. Editing, saving and reloading the existing draft preserved the design. Live cycle and frozen appraisal settings matched.
Completion is visible

Ten appraisals reached acknowledgement and personal report/history exports. The linked discussion and required-document cases both finished at 4. The calibrated case retained original manager rating 4 and human final rating 3.
note: The two unfinished appraisals are deliberate fixtures: one self-assessment pending and one saved unrated manual draft. Retained cycle drafts are separate from appraisal totals.

title: Historical results and downloadable reports
caption: Historical result: final rating 3, acknowledgement recorded, and original manager/calculated rating 4 retained in the outcome narrative.
facts: Results and history are easy to reach

Current/History selection, search, year filters, clear filters and employee scope passed. Reversible removal/restoration retained the result and acknowledgement. Fresh Momo owner reads also showed two existing completed reviews and a final-4 acknowledged report; six independent role-access checks passed.
Reports keep the actual human decision

Individual and history CSVs downloaded for the completed synthetic journeys. Calibration reports retain readable employee IDs and original/calibrated ratings. The Momo DEMO manager also downloaded the team-history CSV: one header and the exact two existing acknowledged DEMO results.
Historical evidence stays downloadable

Completed reports expose only permitted, read-only files. The canonical report retained five files and safe filenames/acknowledgement date in its 5,776-byte CSV. The calibrated case's TXT download matched all 157 original bytes. Unauthorized reads were denied.
note: Momo reads/CSV preceded the user's later DEMO-membership removal; they are historical receipts, not new completions. After 590e deployment all ten existing Momo assessments and two appraisals retained exact raw hashes. Native Print/save PDF remains unverified.

title: Saved work and unfinished-review privacy
caption: The same appraisal opens in Manual Mode after reload, with cycle-specific questions and no required AI connection gate.
facts: Save partial work without inventing a rating

The AI-enabled manual draft retained exact achievements after the main-save confirmation and reload. Communication was cleared and both it and the overall rating stayed unrated; the draft remained unsubmitted.
Manual choice survives navigation
Choosing Use manual retains the form choice in the URL. Reload opens the manual form without a required ChatGPT gate. A human rating is still required on submission.
Own work and draft privacy are preserved

The existing check-in used Edit draft, save, reload and submit on the same record. Legacy viewers retained the employee's own work while hiding unfinished manager and peer material. Independent scope denials passed.
note: D29 passed in the real browser: central logout, private History opening sign-in, canonical Identity form and normal HR login back to the dashboard. No empty private workspace remained. Return to the original deep link was not asserted.

title: Feedback, recognition and chosen evidence
caption: After the fifth distinct response, the subject sees Anonymous cards without other-author names or response dates.
facts: Feedback handoffs complete

Personal feedback/recognition, private and organization audiences, project request/accept/respond/acknowledge and a declined invitation all persisted. Chosen appraisal feedback retained its reviewer snapshot without automatic rating changes.
Five distinct authors control anonymous release

Five signed-in synthetic reviewers accepted and responded in the browser. Checkpoints 1-4 withheld content; the fifth released five anonymous responses. Independent 118/118 checks covered summaries, content, known IDs, scope and notifications.
Privacy follows the actual viewer

Requester and subject see cohort-safe progress and one generic cohort notification. Other authors' identity, request links and timing stay hidden. Each author can read their own metadata, including HR; HR has no wider anonymity exception.
note: Ambiguous-send retry uses one immutable payload/key and has real-service regression coverage. In-app delivery is verified; external email/chat delivery requires connected prerequisites.

title: Development, support and succession completion
caption: The development plan is Completed at 70% actual progress. Completion does not fabricate 100% progress.
facts: Development can be finished

The employee saved goal progress 60% and skill progress 40%; the manager updated them to 65% and 45%. Notes, completed activity and check-in survived. Explicit completion retained actual progress of 70%. Independent read/scope checks passed 14/14.
Succession remains a human decision

HR read saved evidence, confirmed/removed the candidate, edited criticality/review date and closed/reopened/closed the slate. Decision audit and rationale remain; closed talent is readonly with frozen final 3.
Support completion protects its evidence

Employee and manager notes remain separate. A prospective extension retained its 20 December review date through completion, including the prior decision, reason and actor in history. Both completed plans reject later milestone edits without changing stored evidence.
note: D26 passed in the browser and independent API checks on revision 86d2. The earlier already-lost date was not reconstructed. The subsequent D27 calibration read-only UI also passed its separate deployed replay on cd86.

title: Competency, talent and calibration
caption: Historical competency report selector: Version 1 is Superseded, with its original finalization time and unchanged previous-report notice.
facts: Competency definitions and assessment are usable

Published strategy and role versions, a reviewed import and manual assessment reached a human Suitable decision. HR saved, reloaded and submitted manual oral evidence, then published report version 3.
History and audiences survive new versions

Version 3 is Current; versions 1 and 2 are Superseded with unchanged stored findings and rationale. The employee report excludes assessor-only oral material. Individual and two-page cohort PDFs exported; filtering Draft returned zero and clearing returned one.
Calibration and talent preserve evidence

Human calibration changed 4 to 3 with a recorded reason and retained original manager rating 4. Closed talent is read-only. Deployed D27 also passed: completed fields are read-only, saved rating/reason remain and Save/Submit are absent. Sixteen fresh OIDC actors, 96 authority checks and 12 invalid probes retained both complete appraisal records unchanged.
note: Historical PDFs retain content while reflecting Current/Superseded status. The optional CV feature and nonassigned-HR controls are verified separately on page 9. Human decisions and existing Momo history remained unchanged.

title: Storage, calls and external providers
caption: The selected reviewer sees all four file formats. Employee and reviewer downloads matched the original hashes.
facts: Cloudinary files retain their original bytes

Appraisal files use authenticated Cloudinary storage. TXT, PDF, DOCX and PPTX uploads survived reload and downloaded with exact original hashes for employee and reviewer. A new valid PDF extracted one page with AI skipped; historical files remained retained.
Generated audio and video crossed TURN

Both scripted peers connected through relay-to-relay TURN in 11.64 seconds. Each received 42 RTP packets with decoded changing video and simultaneous audio. Sixteen authentication/HTTP checks passed. Both left with recording off; no device media was used.
Live providers have separate transaction receipts

Canonical SMTP reached the Gmail inbox with SPF, DKIM and DMARC passing. Genuine OIDC OKR AI returned three valid fictional objectives without saving. Momo calendar create/cancel passed. After D28's tested two-backend release, the original support-plan AI form generated six editable fields; no employee was chosen or plan saved.
note: Momo Learning SSO passed; course completion/Performance sync was not tested. Calendar cancellation retained a provider tombstone. Browser-created external delivery, two-browser device media, recording/transcription and native print remain unverified.

title: Optional CV requests and private evidence
caption: Authorized, nonassigned HR in the Draft assessment Evidence view: CV Ready, with permitted Download, Retention and Remove controls. No new score or final outcome was published.
facts: Request a CV for this role appraisal

The manager launched the role-based appraisal through the normal form with CV requested. The checkbox started unchecked; confirmation included the request. The selected role/version and request were frozen for this appraisal. Missing CV remains optional and does not block submission.
Employee upload and assessor handoff

The employee selected a fictional PDF, uploaded it, reloaded and downloaded the exact 3,600 original bytes. The manager downloaded the same SHA-256 hash. The ready file retained its author, name, role/version and participant/assessor audience.
Permissions and human outcomes remain intact

Four ordinary OIDC roles passed independent private Cloudinary, scanner/hash, no-store and scope checks; a nonactor received 403. Nonassigned HR had permitted controls, while the employee did not gain assessor/delete powers. Upload created no finding, result, AI draft or automatic rating.
note: This is a completed request-to-evidence handoff, not a newly finalized appraisal. Optional/default/off/retry/invalid/closed/report-reference contracts also passed source tests. All required 590e verification steps passed; the workflow was cancelled afterward during artifact handling.
